title: The 6 Best Dehumidifiers Under $250
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for dehumidifiers under $250, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dehumidifiers under $250 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Frigidaire FFAP5033W1 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day moisture removal, 4,500 sq ft coverage, Built-in condensate pump for continuous drainage, Rated to operate down to 41°F.
strengths: Highest raw capacity of the picks in this price bracket
41°F operating floor covers a cold basement most competitors can't handle
Built-in pump and Energy Star certification typically both included at this price
limitations: No app connectivity, unlike the Midea Cube
Larger footprint than the Midea Cube's nested form factor
features: Built-in condensate pump for continuous drainage
Energy Star certified with washable filter

products.name: Midea Cube 35-Pint Smart Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft, Built-in pump with included drain hose, Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app, works with Alexa.
strengths: App control and Alexa compatibility are rare at this price for any brand
Quietest compressor of the four models reviewed in this category
Expandable Cube tank cuts how often it needs emptying
limitations: 35-pint capacity is lower than the Frigidaire or TOSOT's 50-pint rating
Typically sits near the top of this price bracket at full retail
Learning the Cube's lift-and-twist mechanism takes a try or two
features: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft
Built-in pump with included drain hose
Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app, works with Alexa

products.name: TOSOT 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Internal Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft, Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through a 19-foot hose, Energy Star certified and UL listed.
strengths: 15-foot pump lift is the longest reach of the units in this price bracket
Auto-restart keeps settings intact after a brief power interruption
limitations: Owner reports note compressor longevity concerns after 2 to 3 seasons
Louder at full fan speed than the Midea Cube
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft
